mentions.name: LLM Archive Downloader
mentions.description: An open-source command-line script that downloads and archives open-source AI models locally in one command. Users pick models such as Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, and Whisper, storing about 200GB for the full set or ~40GB for the essentials, so the models remain available offline.
mentions.problem: Open-source models could potentially disappear due to licensing changes or restrictions, leaving no local copies.
mentions.source_excerpt: LLM Archive Downloader. Got paranoid one night about open-source models potentially disappearing (licensing changes, restrictions, who knows). So I built a script to download and archive them locally. One command, pick what you want — Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, Whisper, the works. ~200GB total or grab the essentials (~40GB).
